The goal is a vertically-stacked layout: an action button on the left, customer information in the middle, and financials plus an input field on the right. My focus is now on refining the mobile item structure, having settled on conditional rendering. I'm visualizing a responsive, vertically-oriented design using `<div>` elements and Flexbox. The mental model has evolved to include print buttons, customer details with bolded names, and total money display. I'm now zeroing in on a highly compact mobile layout, aiming for a maximum of two rows. I've structured it as a Grid/Flex hybrid, allowing for a Print button, Name (bolded, truncated), Address (smaller, truncated to two lines), Status badges/Notes, Total Money Input and Edit Button.
